column1: # RFC 3339 §4.3 reads "-00:00" as an offset that is unknown rather than known to
# be UTC, a distinction "+00:00" has no way to spell. The official suite's
# optional/format/date-time.json carries neither spelling, and it carries no
# offset missing its minute field. The two out-of-range offset rows below
# restate cases the suite already carries, kept so the offset boundary reads
# Row format: see loadVectorFile in vectors_test.go.
